problems.title: Multiple testing
problems.statement: 20 independent tests at α = 0.05, all nulls true.

problems.title: Sharpe t-stat
problems.statement: Annualised Sharpe SR over T years: t ≈ SR·√T.

problems.title: Max of noise

parts.prompt: Expected best Sharpe for N = 100 (≈ SE·√(2 ln N))?

problems.solution: ≈ 1.75 and ≈ 2.15: a best-of-1,000 Sharpe above 2 is expected from noise.

problems.title: p-value meaning

options: If the null were true, data this extreme would occur about 3% of the time
There's a 97% chance the effect is real
There's a 3% chance the null is true
It says nothing about the effect size

hints: A p-value conditions on the null.

problems.title: Winner's curse in research
problems.statement: A study with low power finds a significant effect.

parts.prompt: Its estimated effect size is likely…

problems.solution: Only overestimates clear the significance bar at low power (type M error).

problems.title: Survivorship
problems.statement: Backtesting on today's index members over 20 years.

options: upward: firms that failed or were dropped are excluded

problems.title: Parameter stability
problems.statement: A strategy's Sharpe: 2.1 with a 20-day lookback, 0.3 with 19 days and 0.4 with 22 days.

options: likely overfit: the performance is a spike, not a plateau

hints: Real effects are smooth in parameters.
problems.solution: Prefer strategies whose performance is stable across nearby parameters.
